thread:
riley: Heads-up: nightly usage agg doubled some metered records last night, causing ~230 invoices to be overstated. Found it when recon flagged a 2x spike at 02:00 UTC.

jordan: yikes. is this the daylight-savings window bug again? which job runs at that time?

riley: aggregator job usage-aggregator-v2 window=[00:00-02:00] UTC. On 2026-11-07 there was an extra hour, and our sliding window grouped one hour twice.

kevin: we had a separate fix for DST in analytics last year but not in billing. Did webhook replaying cause duplicate Stripe invoice items?

billing-bot: [automated] webhook-inspector: invoiceitem.created events 01:58-02:05 => 410 events, of which 198 have duplicate external_id hashes. DLQ: 3. /alerts/usage-dup-1964

ada: sample backend log:```
2026-11-07T02:01:12Z INFO aggregate_window start=2026-11-07T01:00:00Z end=2026-11-07T02:00:00Z counts=1245
2026-11-07T02:01:12Z INFO sliding_window emitted for window=2026-11-07T01:00:00Z counts=1245
2026-11-07T02:01:13Z INFO sliding_window emitted for window=2026-11-07T01:00:00Z counts=1245
```
Looks like the same window emitted twice.

riley: how many customers affected?

jordan: quick query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM stripe_invoice_items WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-11-07T01:58Z' AND '2026-11-07T02:06Z' AND amount_change > 0; => 214 unique customers, median overcharge $12.

kevin: remediation plan: 1) stop aggregator job (done), 2) deploy hotfix to dedupe by (customer_id, usage_window_hash) so duplicates ignored, 3) schedule backfill to remove duplicate invoice items from Stripe and NetSuite, 4) notify finance + CS for messaging.

ada: I'll open PR for dedupe change. Also add metric 'usage_dup_rate' to console.

ops-bot: [automated] job-runner: usage-aggregator-v2 stopped by riley at 1964120200.

jordan: finance needs to approve net-zero backfill. What's the risk of touching Stripe invoiceitems? Are any invoices already paid?

kevin: about 60 invoices already paid; for paid invoices we'd issue credit memos in NetSuite and create corresponding credit notes in Stripe. For unpaid we can safely remove duplicate items before finalization. Backfill plan will: --dry-run, generate per-invoice diff, mark actions; runbook attached.

riley: sample backfill command I tested in staging:```bash
python tools/remove_duplicate_usage_items.py --start 2026-11-07T01:55Z --end 2026-11-07T02:10Z --mode dry-run --output /tmp/dup_report.csv
```
Dry run shows 214 invoices with duplicate item ids to remove (csv attached in ticket).

jordan: finance approves dry-run and staging run. Prod run requires exec board ok after runbook review. Sophie from finance will sign off by EOD.

kevin: created PR 4872 for dedupe and PR 4873 for backfill tool. CI green. tagging @riley for canary deploy.

billing-bot: [automated] deploy-bot: PRs 4872/4873 queued for canary.

riley: doing canary now. will monitor charge reconciliation dashboards. ops-bot will alert on >5% usage_dup_rate.

ada: note for postmortem: add timezone/unit tests and simulate DST shift in nightly test harness. Also add idempotency keys for invoiceitem creation in webhook worker.

jordan: thanks. please loop CS and prepare templated credits language.

ops-bot: [automated] alert: usage_dup_rate=0.02 at 1964120500 (canary)

riley: canary looks good, merging and scheduling prod backfill tonight at 23:00 PST after finance sign-off.

jordan: please add an incident stub in postmortems channel with the root cause summary.

kevin: will follow up with runbook and credit memo template.
